mapper.select: SELECT parkingFloor AS floor, COUNT(recordId) AS count FROM parking_spots WHERE recordId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY parkingFloor ORDER BY parkingFloor ASC
SELECT TO_CHAR(exitTime, 'MM') || '월' AS month, COALESCE(SUM(finalFee), 0) AS sales FROM parking_records WHERE exitTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(exitTime, 'MM') ORDER BY month ASC
